DIAGNOSIS READY: Actinic Keratosis.

The description of a rough, sandpaper-like plaque on the dorsal hand of a 65-year-old with outdoor exposure is classic for actinic keratosis. Given the lack of pain and tenderness, this is consistent with a premalignant lesion rather than an infected wound or squamous cell carcinoma.
